evidence.reason: The validator expands each interval into a set via range() and scope() builds one set per row, while validate() constructs all three scope maps before the subset check. There is no aggregate cap on decoded entries, so a small record with many wide intervals can allocate millions of set entries before rejection. The existing per-file and byte caps limit encoded size or one file, not total decoded work; this is a resource-exhaustion defect. Compute the total from the interval bounds before building any set and reject over the chosen bound.
